ruleDefinitions.name: Wow6432Node Windows NT CurrentVersion Autorun Keys Modification
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects modification of autostart extensibility point (ASEP) in registry. Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\SOFTWARE\\\\Wow6432Node\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\ NT\\\\CurrentVersion.*") AND (registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\Appinit\\_Dlls.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Image\\ File\\ Execution\\ Options.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Drivers32.*")) AND  NOT ((Details = "\(Empty\)" OR Details = "\\REGISTRY\\MACHINE\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\ NT\\CurrentVersion\\Image\ File\ Execution\ Options"))
